invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Pair, as the last line is 'return Pair.of(...)'.
The first element of the returned Pair (partitionPathStatMap) is always populated (never set to null).
The second element of the returned Pair (globalStat) is always a new WorkloadStat, not null.
The code assumes inputRecords is non-null before iterating over it.
